module: Small vehicle editor utility: computes the cumulative node mass of the vehicle from the physical mass actually simulated (obj:getNodeMass).
notes: obj:getNodeMass is called up to 3 times per node (not cached).
Masses in kg (inferred: unit of jbeam node masses).
If the table is empty: returns 0, -math.huge, math.huge.

calculateNodesWeight.desc: Sums the masses of the nodes in the table and also returns the smallest and largest node mass.

nodesTbl.desc: Table of nodes (each with a cid field); v.data.nodes if nil.
